text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah to head extraordinary cabinet meeting on Tuesday.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index rose 16.9 points to 1,881.3 on Monday.
- Economists expect 50,000 job seekers in the employment market over the next five years.
- Communications minister says the state could hold a small stake in a telecommunications firm it plans to establish as a shareholder company.

- Chamber of Commerce and Industry proposes the government should subsidise wages of Kuwaitis working for private sector firms over a five-year span. Most of Kuwait's national expensive workforce is currently hired by the state, while the private sector depends on foreign workers.
- Officials from the stock exchanges of Kuwait, Egypt and Lebanon to meet in Beirut on December 12.
- Emir invites Arab Gulf leaders to hold their next annual summit in Kuwait.
- Kuwaitis make only 36 percent of total workforce, commerce chamber report says.
